normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _owners only serves the initialization of owners/isOwner.
Constructor parameter _required only writes the required threshold.
owner parameter is the privileged address added by addOwner (also consumed by removeOwner/replaceOwner).
newOwner parameter exists solely for replaceOwner.
changeRequirement's _required parameter is folded into the onlyWallet threshold update.
destination parameter is stored as the transaction target by submitTransaction.
value parameter is stored as the transaction ether value.
data parameter is stored as the transaction payload.
transactionId parameter is the identifier validated and mutated by confirmTransaction.
dataLength parameter controls the size argument of the assembly call in external_call.
amount parameter feeds the daily-limit arithmetic in isUnderLimit.
_dailyLimit parameter is the value written by changeDailyLimit (and the derived constructor).
Local transactionId is the return value routed through submitTransaction.
Local txn is the storage pointer mutated by executeTransaction.
Local result is the boolean produced by the assembly call.
Local _confirmed is the quorum cache driving the daily-limit branch.
Local loop index i is used to traverse owners inside confirmation counting.
Local count accumulates confirmations in getConfirmationCount.
from parameter defines the lower bound of getTransactionIds.
to parameter defines the upper bound of getTransactionIds.
pending filter flag is consumed by getTransactionCount.
executed filter flag is consumed by getTransactionCount.
